status: Synthetic stated-condition examples; not observations or a physical classifier.

cases.condition: A back-face surface-layer gouge, with no stock fold or break. Assume the existing dot extent class has already been established; a point annotation does not establish it.
cases.reason: Surface-layer damage without a stock fold is not a crease.

cases.condition: A single light stock fold on the back face; the surface is intact and the card layers are not split.
cases.reason: A light crease need not break the surface; the stock fold excludes deep.

cases.condition: A back-face crease that breaks through the card layers, causing a paper split along the fold.
cases.reason: The stock fold and split exclude deep; not every paper tear is a crease.

cases.condition: A localized back-face indentation with no stock fold and no surface-layer gouge; classified as a dent.
cases.reason: No supported dent encoding or penalty is defined; neither a fold nor a gouge is stated.
